text.text_excerpt: I can't review the actual hotel since I didn't stay here. But I did leave my bags in their storage ($3 per bag) since my Airbnb wasn't ready. All the employees were BEYOND friendly and accommodating even tho I wasn't a guest. The front desk guy even gave great recommendations on places to eat and things to do! Everything was super clean, well maintained and had a nice modern feel. It's in a great location, walking distances to many different spots as well as the streetcar. It definitely made me want to consider staying here next time I'm in the area.

Yes, this hotel just opened. Yes, it has its quirks to work out. But it has great potential and for my family of four, it was great. We can't wait to go back. We just hope the rates are still reasonable then. I highly recommend it. On our first night, Darrin the bellman helped us with our luggage. He got a kick out of our staycation when he asked where we were from. He told us everything about our room. I hope he got our tip that we left for him since he went home early that night. Like other reviews, the Superior queen rooms are very big. Just what my family needed. It was similar to a wheelchair accessible room, nice and wide and roomy. What a beautiful and modern hotel! I had a two-night stay here in one of the deluxe rooms with 2 queen beds. Pros: - Friendly staff! From checking in to checking out, each and every staff member I interacted with was super nice. Erica, at the front desk, was especially welcoming. - Great rooms! Clean, spacious, and lots of outlets for both USBs and standard power plugs. - Good location. The Canal streetcar line has a stop that is literally right in front of the hotel. The bus that goes to the New Orleans airport also has a stop right around the corner. - Decent fitness room! Towels and water are provided.
